title: Expand Phase 2 pool admission
summary:
Re-review after spec annotation. The only blocking issue from the previous review — missing integration test (acceptance criterion #5) — is now resolved by the explicit '(OPTIONAL — skipped per RAM constraint)' marker added to the task spec in commit d01c8d7. The implementer's choice to skip the integration test is now formally correct. All other criteria pass as in the previous review:

1. All 6 new config keys present with correct defaults matching the friend's values (PHASE2_CV_MIN_WORST_RETURN=-8.0, PHASE2_CV_MIN_WORST_PF=0.80, PHASE2_CV_MAX_WORST_DD=18.0, PHASE2_CV_MIN_FOLD_TRADES=10, PHASE2_KEEP_TOP_RULES=140, PHASE2_STRICT_POSITIVE_GOOD=True).
2. _passes_pool_admission_impl uses new relaxed CV_* thresholds for cv_fold=True: val return >= -8%, PF >= 0.80, DD <= 18% (both train and val), min trades >= 10. Non-CV holdout path unchanged.
3. _build_pool_from_archive caps pool at PHASE2_KEEP_TOP_RULES=140, sorted by deployability_rank_score descending.
4. New test file tests/unit/test_phase2_pool_admission.py has 10 cases (exceeding spec minimum of 4), covering: mildly-negative pass, return rejection, DD rejection, PF rejection, relaxed trade floor, strict trade floor enforcement, positive-good gate non-crash, holdout path unchanged, config key presence, and default values. All 10 pass.
5. Two existing test files (test_phase2_support.py, test_phase2_cv_admission.py) have minimal 1-line patches to set PHASE2_STRICT_POSITIVE_GOOD=False — harmless and correctly scoped.
6. No changes to evaluator_v5.ipynb, GPU engine, EvoX runner, Phase 3/4, or JSON output contract.

Full approval — all acceptance criteria met. Ready for merge.
